nodes.description: Core storage struct holding epoch, balance, provider, accounts, epochs and candidates for the Ethic Money DAO system.
Core storage struct of the Pool contract holding balance, provider, paused flag and per-account state.
ERC20 internal accounting maps and total supply used by Ethic token transfers and approvals.
Per-owner nonce map consumed by permit to prevent signature replay.
EIP-712 domain separator used to hash permit messages.
Externally callable deposit of UNI-V2 into the pool; transfers tokens in then increments staged balance.
Externally callable withdrawal of staged UNI-V2; transfers tokens out then decrements staged balance.
Externally callable claim of rewarded ETHC; transfers tokens out then decrements claimable balance.
Moves staged balance into bonded balance and computes phantom rewards.
Moves bonded balance back to staged/claimable and adjusts phantom balance.
Provides rewarded ETHC as liquidity to the UNI-V2 pair and bonds the resulting LP tokens.
DAO-only rescue function that transfers an arbitrary token out of the pool.
Internal helper that quotes DAI, transfers tokens into the pair and mints LP tokens.
Invariant check that pool UNI-V2 balance covers staged plus bonded totals.
Caller-controlled address used for account state, role checks and DAO ownership checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for oracle cumulative price and epoch time computation.
DAO-only oracle entrypoint that initializes on first call and otherwise returns an updated price.
Computes the time-weighted price from Uniswap cumulative values and elapsed time.
Reads pair reserves and cumulative price to seed the oracle baseline.
Upgrades the proxy implementation and delegatecalls initialize() on the new implementation.
delegatecall into an externally supplied implementation address during upgrade.
ecrecover based signature verification in the permit function.
EIP-2612 style permit that verifies a signature and sets an allowance.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that skips allowance decrement when allowance is uint256(-1).
Minter-only ETHC mint function.
Initializer that deploys the Ethic token contract.
Initializer that deploys the Oracle contract and calls its setup.
Initializer that deploys the Pool contract bound to the oracle pair.
External univ2().transferFrom pull executed before staged balance state update in deposit.
External univ2().transfer push executed before staged balance state update in withdraw.
External ethic().transfer push executed before claimable balance state update in claim.
External DAI transferFrom pulling user DAI into the Uniswap pair.
External IUniswapV2Pair.mint call minting LP tokens to the pool.
External calls to the Uniswap pair for cumulative prices and reserves during oracle updates.
Local DAI amount computed in addLiquidity from reserves quote.
Local amount of newly minted UNI-V2 LP tokens returned by addLiquidity.
Local sum of total rewarded and total phantom computed in bond.
Local phantom amount credited to the bonder.
Local claimable amount computed for unbonding participant.
Local phantom amount burned on unbond.
Local elapsed time derived from block timestamps in Oracle.updatePrice.
Local cumulative price value selected by ETHC index in Oracle.updatePrice.
uint256 value parameter of Pool.deposit.
address account parameter of Ethic.mint.
uint256 amount parameter of Ethic.mint.
owner/spender/value/deadline/v/r/s parameters of Permittable.permit.
address newImplementation parameter of Upgradeable.upgradeTo.
Address recovered from ecrecover in permit.
Internal ERC20 transfer of balances and Transfer event.
Internal ERC20 approval write and Approval event.
Computes the current epoch from block timestamp and the epoch strategy.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the account argument to deposit and gates the onlyFrozen/notPaused modifiers.
msg.sender determines the account whose staged balance is withdrawn in withdraw.
msg.sender determines the account whose claimable balance is paid out in claim.
msg.sender determines the account bonded in bond.
msg.sender determines the account unbonded in unbond.
msg.sender determines the account providing liquidity and its rewarded balance check in provide.
emergencyWithdraw is guarded by onlyDao comparing msg.sender with dao().
deposit performs an external transferFrom before incrementing the depositor staged balance.
withdraw performs an external transfer before decrementing the staged balance.
claim performs an external ethic transfer before decrementing the claimable balance.
provide delegates token movement to the addLiquidity helper.
addLiquidity pulls DAI from the user via an external transferFrom before pool accounting completes.
addLiquidity calls the untrusted pair mint externally while pool state is not yet updated.
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on an externally supplied implementation address.
Deployer1.implement invokes upgradeTo and is externally callable without owner restriction.
Deployer2.implement invokes upgradeTo and is externally callable without owner restriction.
Deployer3.implement invokes upgradeTo and is externally callable without owner restriction.
Deployer1.initialize deploys the Ethic token used for minting.
Deployer2.initialize constructs the Oracle that exposes capture().
Deployer3.initialize constructs the Pool that uses addLiquidity.
permit relies on ecrecover to authorize an allowance change.
block timestamp enters updatePrice and controls the elapsed-time denominator of the price.
epochTime derives the current epoch from block.timestamp and the epoch strategy.
updatePrice reads cumulative prices and reserves from the Uniswap pair.
initializeOracle reads pair cumulative prices and reserves.
deposit validates the pool UNI-V2 invariant via balanceCheck.
withdraw validates the pool UNI-V2 invariant via balanceCheck.
claim validates the pool UNI-V2 invariant via balanceCheck.
bond validates the pool UNI-V2 invariant via balanceCheck.
unbond validates the pool UNI-V2 invariant via balanceCheck.
provide validates the pool UNI-V2 invariant via balanceCheck.
the deposit value parameter flows into staged balance accounting.
the mint account parameter is credited with newly minted ETHC.
the mint amount parameter determines the supply increase.
permit arguments flow into the digest, signature check and allowance write.
the newImplementation parameter flows into setImplementation and delegatecall.
lv_daiAmount is computed inside addLiquidity for the DAI transfer.
lv_newUniv2 is returned by addLiquidity as the minted LP amount.
lv_totalRewardedWithPhantom is used to derive the bonder phantom reward.
lv_newPhantom is credited to the bonder in bond.
lv_newClaimable is credited as claimable on unbond.
lv_lessPhantom is deducted from the unbonder phantom balance.
lv_timeElapsed is derived from timestamps in updatePrice.
lv_priceCumulative is selected by index in updatePrice.
lv_recovered is the address returned by ecrecover in permit.
Ethic.transferFrom invokes the inherited ERC20 _transfer.
Ethic.transferFrom invokes _approve to deduct non-infinite allowances.
ERC20 balances and allowances back the overridden transferFrom logic.
deposit writes staged balance into the Pool storage struct.
permit increments the owner nonce to prevent replay.
permit uses the EIP-712 domain separator when hashing the digest.
an attacker-controlled token can re-enter the pool through the transferFrom callback during deposit.
the ETHC transfer in claim can invoke a contract recipient that re-enters claim or related pool functions.
the Uniswap pair mint callback during addLiquidity can re-enter pool accounting before it is updated.
Deployer1.initialize writes the provider state in Storage._state.
Deployer2.initialize writes the oracle provider into Storage._state.
Deployer3.initialize writes the pool address into Storage._state.
upgradeTo is inherited by the Deployer contracts whose storage is Storage._state.

normalization_plan.reason: local temporary DAI amount computed and consumed entirely inside addLiquidity.
local LP mint amount produced by addLiquidity with no independent security semantics.
intermediate reward sum used only for the phantom computation in bond.
intermediate phantom amount credited during bond.
intermediate claimable amount computed during unbond.
intermediate phantom deduction computed during unbond.
intermediate elapsed-time value driving the oracle price update.
intermediate cumulative price selection used only inside updatePrice.
deposit amount parameter whose only role is the staged balance update inside deposit.
mint recipient parameter consumed directly by Ethic.mint.
mint amount parameter consumed directly by Ethic.mint.
permit arguments feed the digest and allowance write inside permit.
implementation address parameter flows into the unsafe delegatecall in upgradeTo.
recovered signer address is produced by and validated around the ecrecover unsafe operation.
